2027 closes with the truce extended and most commitments delivered: the US-China reciprocal same-day suspensions run to Feb 9 2028, the TSMC-Broadcom Q4 review locked 2028 lanes on a qualified-output metric, and the Samsung-NVIDIA HBM4E planning dialogue went operational, establishing a genuine second HBM source for 2028. ASML's December 3800F tranche landed on time despite a weak delivery track record.
